text: This report provides an update on the implementation of the WSP Parking Study conducted in 2015-2016 and the effects these implementations have had on the evolution of Exhibition Place.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Requested the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, in consultation with the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority and the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning to investigate shared parking assets for investment in the Liberty Village Neighbourhood and report to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place in 2019.
